hypotheses.S0_label_coverage: At least 35 of 50 declared labels have 50 positive examples in each split.
hypotheses.S1_model_competence: At least 25 eligible labels have held-out AUROC at least 0.55 under the model's exact output contrast.
hypotheses.S2_fixed_coalitions_recover_known_featur: The best layer's median held-out 64-channel AUROC is at least 0.70.
hypotheses.S3_coalitions_beat_single_neurons: At the best layer, the median 64-channel AUROC exceeds the median one-channel AUROC by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.S4_depth_adds_context: Layer 4's median 64-channel AUROC exceeds Layer 0 by at least 0.02.
hypotheses.S5_neuron_aligned_ontology_is_sufficient: At least 75% of competent labels have a single native neuron within 0.03 AUROC of their best 64-channel coalition across Layers 0-4.
hypotheses.S6_embedding_reinjection_control: The best model-layer coalition exceeds the current-token unigram baseline by at least 0.03 median AUROC.
hypotheses.S7_evaluation_is_held_out: Labels, examples, and coalition channels used for evaluation remain disjoint from discovery examples.
hypotheses.S8_depth_signal_survives_exact_current_t: Layer 4's median held-out top-64 AUROC within identical-current-token groups is at least 0.60.
